sourceAttempts.result: Read both reach itineraries and all four launch pages; verified mileage, current/wood hazards and Hyak landing constraints.
Read Jurgens and Community access pages; confirmed river miles 10.6/8.9, carry lengths, steep gangway and the faster/shallow section below Cook Park.
Followed current homepage to Boat Oregon map and queried its public access, obstruction and dam layers. The former obstruction app URL is retired; the replacement map supplies current layers.

Access query returned all 11 matching records without transfer truncation. Selected six named launch facilities; none had an open-access closure status in the returned attributes. Null status is not proof of suitability.

Reviewed all 214 obstruction and 163 dam records without transfer truncation. Two river-right tree reports lie downstream of Crystal Lake and upstream of Michael’s Landing, outside both selected reaches. No reported obstruction in the selected Tualatin corridor; changing/unreported hazards remain possible.

Manager pages confirm public facilities, boat ramps and park restrictions. Hyak is dawn-dusk with no overnight camping or parking. Peoria one-night river-traveler camping requires coordination; itinerary remains a day trip.

City water-trail directory confirms accesses. Indexed current projects page describes fall 2026 Community playground renovation; direct page fetch returned 403. Marine Board access status and trail launch pages also checked; no claim of a blanket all-clear.

Instantaneous-values API returned 2026-09-09 observations for Corvallis 14171600 (4440 cfs, 07:15 PDT) and West Linn 14207500 (289 cfs, 07:20 PDT). Both are proxy context outside these exact reaches; no verified recreational scoring range transferred.

Inspected all six launch areas using World Imagery exports with returned EPSG:4326 extents. Refined four access-area points to approximate ramp water entries. Peoria requires an alcove connector around a wooded island; its nearest NHD mainstem cannot be used as a launch shortcut.

Added Peoria–Michael’s, Crystal Lake–Michael’s and Peoria–Hyak as planning-only combinations using the already reviewed public launches, adjacent Water Trail itinerary guidance and the prior coordinate/obstruction audit. No new scoring threshold was inferred.

coordinateMethod.method: Approximate infrastructure water entries read from georeferenced imagery, cross-identified with manager/trail pages and Marine Board launch records. Canopy and changing waterline limit precision; no claim of survey accuracy.
coordinateMethod.peoriaConnector: Reviewed alcove channel east of island; joins NHD at -123.211383,44.456202. Do not substitute straight-line nearest-mainstem snap across island.
coordinateMethod.imageryAcquisitionDate: Not established; retrieval and review occurred 2026-09-09. Imagery identifies infrastructure, not current water levels or operational status.
coordinateMethod.reviewLimit: Approximate positions, with canopy, image registration and changing waterline uncertainty; use the named managed launch and current posted access. Hydrography offsets are retained honestly rather than forcing coordinates onto the centerline.
